HARDEGG'S JERUSALEM HOTEL JAFFA (Palestine)

sata, Nov. 2.1,,911

Telegr. HOTEL HARDEGG

Mollie dear:: i I read your share lilles on the boat aud was much dictusud tolearn what the doeler sact aboutit. alchi we boch Revyan had a Readirr gall blad der. vam glad thise beessel women task you in kandand & hope

tora aud she say you are not meet she Thinks. Idonot thick you hen pass d gael stones as berge did pryou he not had there occurences of pain hefer. They say must prope hen guel atones You ökould faelache dielei advice aboutdeet. Du you Rum. I am corvineshat coffee pr brakfash nas ba d fe me thin
